journey.title: Walk the settings tabs with arrow keys
journey.goal: Each arrow press selects and focuses the next tab

functionalJourney.title: Switch settings sections with the mouse
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a tab shows its panel

guards.title: Tab from the active tab into its panel
guards.goal: Tab leaves the tab list for the active panel

plan.root_cause: Arrow key navigation updates aria-selected but does not move focus to the newly selected tab because the Tab.show() method activates the tab panel without focusing the tab button.
plan.repair_strategy: Add element.focus() in the _activate method's complete callback after setting aria-selected true, ensuring keyboard focus follows selection.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft keys will move focus to the next/previous tab and update aria-selected accordingly, providing expected keyboard operability for the tablist.
functional_risks: Programmatic calls to .show() will now also focus the tab, which may alter focus where callers did not expect it; however this matches the typical user interaction pattern and should not break existing functionality.
verification_requirements: After pressing ArrowRight from the Account tab, focus moves to the Notifications tab and its aria-selected becomes true.
After pressing ArrowLeft from the Notifications tab, focus returns to the Account tab and its aria-selected becomes true.
Initial tab retains focus when no arrow keys are used.
Tab panels still show/hide correctly when tabs are activated via arrow keys or mouse clicks.
The .show() method continues to activate the associated tabpanel.
